sections.note:
In PHIL 479, the student will work with a faculty supervisor to write an honours thesis.
This will normally be a development of a paper previously written for a 400- or 800-level philosophy seminar, though in exceptional circumstances a paper from a 300-level philosophy course can be used.
Optionally, PHIL 479 will culminate in a public presentation of the honours thesis, with audience Q & A.
